overview: A liquid-flow loop under construction for microchannel cold plates and on-chip cooling structures. The intended workflow combines heater power, flow rate, pressure drop, inlet/outlet temperature, and local chip temperature.
overviewZh: 用于微通道冷板和芯片内冷却结构评估的在建液体流动回路，计划结合加热功率、流量、压降、进出口温度和芯片局部温度。
principle: Heat conducts from the chip into channel walls and transfers to flowing coolant by convection. For steady single-phase flow, mass flow and inlet/outlet temperatures give removed heat after heat-loss corrections. Chip temperature gives thermal resistance; extracting a heat-transfer coefficient also requires wall-to-fluid temperature and area. Pressure drop determines hydraulic pumping power.
principleZh: 热量由芯片传导至通道壁，再通过对流传给冷却液。稳态单相流下，结合质量流量与进出口温差，并修正散热损失，可求移除热量。芯片温升用于计算热阻；换热系数还需要壁面–流体温差与换热面积。压降决定液压泵功。
